mechanism: A directly peer-created child is first mirrored into the global controller by ControllerFederationStore._insert_child_mirror.
insert_mirrored_job_config writes only identity, peer-reported resource shape and inherited parent display priority; the peer original execution config is not synchronized by this function.
Schema defaults therefore yield failure0/preemption100, timeoutNULL, constraintsNULL, empty entrypoint/environment and bundle.
Global get_job_status reconstructs a LaunchJobRequest from that mirror row. These displayed fields must not be treated as authoritative original peer child execution settings.
priority_note: Mirror priority is inherited parent seed/display according to source; does not independently attest an explicit child override.
root_vs_child: Root handoff stores its original request; a subsequently peer-created child may instead have only this sparse mirror. This explains why root guards and child readbacks can differ.
relationship_to_A12_report: Mechanism explains the reported global0/100/timeout0/[] pattern. This proof alone does not attest deployed controller revision, actual worker import paths, or original regional child request.
